title: What stangent-link-judge returns with claim-links and fsd.judgeFinerVerdicts on (D145, D124)
description: link-judge-claims-output with partial and unclear added.

claims.description: The ids of the claims this answers (agree, conflict, gap, partial, unclear). Naming one id of a line answers the whole line, unless another link names another of its ids.

page.description: A candidate page's id (agree, conflict, undocumented, partial; optional for gap).

statement.description: The page statement's id, e.g. R3.

covered.description: partial: what the statement does show.

note.description: Why. On unclear, the reason it can't be told.
